$description: Control sizing, icon sizing, and aspect ratios. Control heights drive Button/Input/Select consistency; all meet the 24px min target (44px recommended for primary touch).

control.$description: Interactive control height (Button, Input, Select, etc.)

xs.$description: Min target size (WCAG 2.5.8) — dense tables, chips

icon.$description: Icon box sizes — keep stroke weight consistent across sizes

aspectRatio.$description: Use the unitless ratio in CSS aspect-ratio / native equivalents

screen.$description: Screen economy: the viewport is scarce and bright area costs battery. These are the ceilings a screen must stay under. Thresholds live here, not in the gate, so a project can raise one deliberately and the gate follows.

media-max-block.$description: An image, video or background-image block may not be taller than this share of the viewport. A hero that fills the screen shows the reader nothing they came for and costs the most battery on OLED.

media-max-inline.$description: Media never exceeds its container. Wider than the viewport is a bug, not a bleed.

box-max-viewport-share.$description: A card-like box may cover at most this share of the viewport before it has to justify the space with content.

box-min-content-density.$description: A box over the share above must fill at least this much of its own area with text, controls or media. Below both numbers it is a hollow box.

image-bytes-budget.$description: Total image bytes on one page. Prefer AVIF or WebP with srcset sized to the rendered width.
